summary: Firy Inc. (formerly Skillz) filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026, announcing a notice of full redemption for all $49.671 million outstanding principal of its 10.250% Secured Notes due 2026 at 100.000% of par plus accrued interest, with a Redemption Date of October 15, 2026. UMB Bank, N.A. serves as trustee and paying agent. The company will fund the redemption with proceeds from the previously announced sale of its equity stake in Exit Games, with no new capital raised and no shareholder dilution. This completes full repayment of $300 million in debt and releases all liens.
